traits.name: Elemental Demise
traits.desc: If Exul dies, his body disintegrates in a flash of fire and puff of smoke, leaving behind only the equipment he was wearing or carrying.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Exul's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Comprehend Languages|comprehend languages]], [[Tools/Spells/Tongues|tongues]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Conjure Elemental|conjure elemental]] (earth or fire elemental only), [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Major Image|major image]], [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|plane shift]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Fire|wall of fire]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Exul makes two handaxe attacks or uses his Hurl Flame twice.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (5d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Benign Transportation (Recharges after Malivar Casts a Conjuration Spell of 1st Level or Higher)
traits.desc: As a bonus action, Malivar teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that he can see. If he instead chooses a space within range that is occupied by a willing Small or Medium creature, they both teleport, swapping places.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Malivar is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Acid Splash|acid splash]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Poison Spray|poison spray]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]], [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]], [[Tools/Spells/Unseen Servant|unseen servant]]*
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Cloud Of Daggers|cloud of daggers]]*, [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]]*, [[Tools/Spells/Web|web]]*
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Fireball|fireball]], [[Tools/Spells/Thunder Step|thunder step]]*
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Evard'S Black Tentacles|Evard's black tentacles]]*, [[Tools/Spells/Stoneskin|stoneskin]]
- **5th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Cone Of Cold|cone of cold]]*, [[Tools/Spells/Conjure Elemental|conjure elemental]]*

*Conjuration spell of 1st level or higher

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
